videos.focus: Evaluate an unauthorized financial agent incident by separating observed access, granted permissions, potential harm and the controls required before broader deployment.

complete_compiler_story.summary: Google DeepMind reports that AlphaProof Code agents generated machine-checkable Lean proofs for selected compiled Signal cryptography routines. Humans approved the specifications, while the system produced more than six million proof lines and caught seeded regressions. The result covers stated properties under trusted semantics and contracts; it does not establish that every implementation behavior or security assumption is correct.

complete_compiler_story.headline: A knowledge graph restores answers only after retrieval is tuned

source.title: EcoStatKG: A Knowledge Graph for Ecological Statistics and Numerical Hallucination Evaluation
source.scope: Reviewed the complete 24-page peer-reviewed paper, methods, 500-question benchmark, eight retrieval strategies, six models, ablations, clinical subset and limitations.
source.freshness_reason: Selected as a justified 168-hour scientific-paper fallback because it supplies methods-and-results evidence unavailable from newer announcements.

read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the complete 24-page peer-reviewed paper, methods, 500-question benchmark, eight retrieval strategies, six models, ablations, clinical subset and limitations.

complete_compiler_story.summary: EcoStatKG links ecological statistics from 6,871 Wikipedia articles and tests six models across eight retrieval strategies. Full-index graph retrieval nearly matched GraphRAG, but removing answer-bearing triples sharply reduced accuracy until a similarity threshold was tuned. Wrong retrieval caused most errors, while hallucination after correct injection stayed uncommon. The English-only benchmark and small clinical subset limit transfer.
complete_compiler_story.why_it_matters: Evaluate retrieval before blaming generation. Hold out answer-bearing records, measure wrong-retrieval errors separately, tune one threshold on known questions, and repeat on another domain before treating a graph or GraphRAG pipeline as generally reliable.
complete_compiler_story.related_coverage: Full paper review covered 50,746 statistical triples, 306,231 structural triples, roughly 170 runs, held-out answer removal, threshold recovery and the limited 120-question clinical transfer.
complete_compiler_story.image_alt_intent: A benchmark splits retrieval errors from generation errors as a threshold restores some answers while a held-out set exposes missing evidence.

complete_compiler_story.headline: A Maya-site claim shows why agents must search prior literature

source.title: An AI agent found a Maya site — then prior literature changed the claim
source.scope: Reviewed the complete five-minute post and November 11 correction explaining the LiDAR workflow, missing registry entry, prior 2025 mapping and the author’s stated lack of archaeological expertise.
source.freshness_reason: The date-only timestamp falls outside conservative 24-hour arithmetic, but the same-day correction materially changed the claim and made this the strongest verified agent-audit case.

read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the complete five-minute post and November 11 correction explaining the LiDAR workflow, missing registry entry, prior 2025 mapping and the author’s stated lack of archaeological expertise.

complete_compiler_story.summary: Pietro Miotti’s agent workflow flagged a Maya site in public LiDAR data, but a November 11 correction says researchers had already mapped it in a 2025 paper. The site was absent from the Mexican heritage register the workflow checked. The episode illustrates rediscovery, not archaeological discovery, and the author explicitly says he is not an archaeologist.
complete_compiler_story.why_it_matters: Before announcing an agent’s discovery, search domain literature, contact qualified experts, compare official registries with publication databases, and label unresolved identity questions. Preserve corrections so the workflow rewards verified novelty, not merely a missing database entry.
complete_compiler_story.related_coverage: Complete original post and correction reviewed, including tool path, registry limitation, prior literature and author qualification boundary.
complete_compiler_story.image_alt_intent: A LiDAR agent flags a site, then an official registry, prior paper and domain expert converge on a corrected rediscovery label.

audience_fit.intended_user: Researchers, analysts and communicators using agents to surface possible findings from public data.
audience_fit.practical_action: Search prior literature and authoritative databases, then ask a qualified expert before presenting an agent result as new.
audience_fit.review_action: Record database coverage, unresolved identity questions, expert feedback and corrections beside the original agent output.
audience_fit.usable_outcome: A defensible research claim that distinguishes a novel finding from rediscovery, database omission or mistaken identity.
